name: Maggran's Reserve Letter
summary: At Sun Rock Retreat, Maggran Earthbinder sends a reserve warrior south to relieve Grish Longrunner at the Great Lift. The orders let Grish return home and visit his family.

sections.title: A Sentry Relieved
sections.body:
From Sun Rock Retreat, Maggran Earthbinder sends orders to the Great Lift. Grish Longrunner, a Horde sentry there, is to be relieved by a replacement warrior.

The Great Lift's wooden winches stand far to the south. Grish has kept watch there, but now the new warrior takes his place. Grish can leave his post and return home to visit his family.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Maggran's Reserve Letter?
faq.answer: Maggran Earthbinder's orders relieve Grish Longrunner from his post at the Great Lift in the southern Barrens. A replacement takes his place so Grish can return home and visit his family.
Maggran Earthbinder wrote the letter. He is an elder at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Who is meant to receive it?
faq.answer: The letter is addressed to Grish Longrunner, a Horde guard stationed at the top of the Great Lift. The lift connects the southern Barrens to Thousand Needles.
Carry the letter south across the Barrens to the edge of the Thousand Needles canyon, where the Great Lift stands.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can see how it sends fresh reserves to remote outposts across Kalimdor to care for its scattered forces.
